# AuthorLoft

> The author website builder for independent authors. Create a professional author site with your book catalog, sell direct to readers, and capture newsletter signups — free forever.

AuthorLoft is a multi-tenant SaaS platform that gives independent authors everything they need to build a professional web presence, sell books directly to readers, and grow their newsletter audience — without technical knowledge. Each author gets their own subdomain (e.g. authorname.authorloft.com) or can connect a custom domain.

## Features & Pricing

- [Features](https://www.authorloft.com/features): Full feature list across Free, Standard ($39.99/mo), and Premium ($79.99/mo) plans — book catalog, direct sales, custom domain, flip book previews, AI writing tools, and reader analytics.
- [Pricing](https://www.authorloft.com/pricing): Plan comparison with full pricing details and side-by-side comparison against competitors (Tertulia, StoryOrigin, BookFunnel).

## Blog

- [Blog](https://www.authorloft.com/blog): Tips, guides, and insights for independent authors on selling books direct, building an audience, and growing a newsletter.

## Bookstore

- [Bookstore](https://www.authorloft.com/bookstore): Discover books from independent authors across all genres — buy directly from each author's own site.
